purpose: Evaluation annotations only; never supplied to model, prior estimation, losses, or hyperparameter selection
notes: Manual visible-glass annotation, not ground-truth metric geometry or exact optical material labels.
Detection is scored inside the fixed rear-window ROI; the separate bright right-side window is outside this annotation scope.
Glass-mask boundaries are excluded from detection scoring to reduce manual annotation uncertainty.
Detail crops exclude the reconstructed room's foreground window bars and person as far as possible; exterior structure visible through glass is the appearance target.
